This text and its simplified annotations were authored for ldfreq and are
covered by the package's MIT license. They are not an extract from MASC.
The files illustrate the GrAF 1.0 Penn layout used by Mini-MASC 1.0.
The text has a final newline, which belongs to neither supplied segment.
Regions use zero-based, end-exclusive Unicode-codepoint offsets.

MASC format documentation: https://anc.org/data/masc/corpus/masc-structure/
The actual MASC corpus has separate data terms, stated at:
https://anc.org/data/masc/
